Sample sigma = 0.431 million. Adjustment components: -0.06 million for May hires falling to 5.170 million, -0.04 million for quits still low at 1.9 percent and layoffs up to 1.708 million, -0.04 million for June payroll slowing to +57,000, -0.004 rounding/level judgment, so point = 7.594 - 0.144 = 7.45 million.
